name: jetopia-jeju-driver-tours
description: Request private driver tours, exact server-calculated quotes, and booking assistance for Jeju Island, Korea.

interface.longDescription:
Jetopia helps you plan private driver tours on Jeju Island, Korea, inside ChatGPT.

Share your date, group size and pickup point. Jetopia recommends a suitable vehicle based on passengers and luggage, and returns an exact quote calculated by Jetopia’s server pricing system. Review the total, online deposit and day-of balance, then send a booking request. A request is not confirmed immediately: Jetopia staff check availability and confirm the booking details after reviewing the request and required deposit.

Explore tour options and suggested courses, check a booking request’s status, or contact Jetopia staff about golf, weddings, VIP transport, filming and other special arrangements.
defaultPrompt: Plan a private driver tour in Jeju for my family
Which vehicle fits 6 people with 4 large suitcases?
Check the status of my Jetopia booking request

review.commerce_description: Jetopia accepts booking requests for private driver tours and transport services. Guests may pay a deposit through Jetopia’s checkout page; staff review availability and confirm the booking. The remaining balance, if any, is paid as stated in the confirmed booking details.

publication.release_notes: First release of Jetopia on ChatGPT. Plan a private driver tour in Jeju, get vehicle recommendations for your group and luggage, see an exact quote with the deposit and day-of balance, send a booking request, and check its status.
